title: The Witching Hour
author: Anne Rice
summary: Rowan Mayfair, a neurosurgeon in San Francisco, and Michael Curry, a man who has returned from near death, are drawn to New Orleans and a family of witches. Centuries of Mayfair history surround a spirit named Lasher.
readIf: you enjoy long, lush Gothic family sagas set in New Orleans.
skipIf: you want brisk horror, or you are uncomfortable with incest and sexual violence in the history.
